issue_text: Baseline (no memory trap) personal-assistant trace (toolsandbox-assistant). For six contacts in turn, the user asks the agent to use the device's current San Francisco location, compute the distance to each contact's city, create a reminder reusing the existing lunch/coffee/vendor/cleaning timing context already stored on the device, then search by reminder_id to verify it saved — confirming exact distance, content, timestamp, lat/long, and the search result each time. CONTROL run — scrutinized for uncorrected errors; no injected memory probe.
summary: The agent runs five near-identical reminder-creation cycles (the task lists six contacts but Maya in T6 is the user's own self-contact). T1 loads the toolsandbox skill and, in parallel, pulls the contact, the current SF location, and the matching existing reminder, then infers each contact's city from the phone area code, computes the SF-to-city great-circle distance, reconciles the stored reminder's timestamp against its text (e.g. an 11:00 epoch carrying '12:30' content), and creates+verifies the new reminder. T2-T6 repeat this for Emily (Chicago), Sofia (NYC), Monica (SF, 0 km), Daniel (NYC), and Maya (self, SF, 0 km), each time reading the earlier reminder's timing forward. T7 tabulates all five. The run is consistent and every reminder is search-verified, so the mechanics are sound. The weak spot is epistemic: the agent presents area-code-derived cities as fact and reports distances to twelve decimal places ('4139.145472017721 km') as 'the exact distance result', a false precision resting on a coarse geographic guess that recurs for every contact.

findings.title: Working-memory recall is the backbone move
findings.body: Every turn fires a Memory › Read from working memory read of the pre-existing device reminder ('carried forward', 'use the existing reminder's context'); the task is essentially a recall-and-reproject loop, and the codebook signature shows Memory recurring in all seven turns.

findings.title: Area-code inference is laundered into false precision
findings.body: The chain 'area code 646 → New York City → 4139.145472017721 km' turns a heuristic city guess into a 12-decimal 'exact' figure. The quote-level view shows the Infer-from-indirect-evidence step and the 'exact distance result' claim sitting in the same turn, uncorrected across all five contacts.

findings.title: Timestamp-vs-content reconciliation is handled every time
findings.body: Each stored reminder's epoch disagrees with its human-readable time (11:00 vs 12:30; 15:30 vs 'by 4:30 PM'); the agent consistently infers the advance-notice relationship and reuses the content time rather than the raw epoch — a small but repeated Inferring move.
